name: Autodrome de Linas-Montlhéry Full Circuit
notes: The full 12.5 km Montlhéry circuit, formed in 1925 by grafting a road course through the Essonne valley onto the banked Piste de Vitesse of 1924. Cars leave the concrete bowl for a long, undulating run through the woods and farmland south of the autodrome before rejoining the banking at speed. It was the home of the French Grand Prix in 1925, 1927, 1931 and 1933 through 1937, and the combination of a high-speed oval with a genuine road circuit made it unlike anything else in Europe.
author: Legion, WeikangCai
